- When sentiment is positive (≥0.2) in recent days, model tends to underreact — increase forecast slightly to align with sentiment-driven momentum.  
- Model consistently underestimates price spikes after a 3–5 day downtrend; apply a 2–5% upward bias to forecast after such dips.  
- After a sharp upward move (e.g., >10% from prior 5-day avg), model overreacts and overshoots — cap forecast at 10–15% above prior peak.  
- If sentiment is flat (0.0) for 5+ consecutive days, model exhibits mean reversion bias — adjust forecast downward by 1–3% to avoid overcorrection.  
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in capturing late-period volatility — add 1–2% upward adjustment for days 25–30 if sentiment is rising.
